plugin_codegen.title: Code Generator
plugin_codegen.description: Free code generator: read an existing business table or define a new one, generate a Go module and frontend pages from a recommended config, preview them, then download a zip

tables.name: Table
tables.hint: Pick an existing business table, or create one here (the package includes migrations for all three engines)
tables.emptyHint: The generator only reads business tables — framework tables (sys_) and plugin tables (plg_) are excluded. Create one here, or create it in your database and refresh.
tables.loadFailedHint: Check the network, or make sure the code generator plugin is enabled, then retry.

define.title: New business table
define.description: Structure only: the package includes mysql / mariadb / postgres migrations and the table is created on restart; the plugin never writes to the database
define.name: Table name
define.nameHint: The biz_ prefix is added automatically; the module name defaults to the name without it
define.migrationHint: Use the next number in your project's migrations/business
define.softDelete: Soft delete (adds deleted_at; deletes only mark rows)
define.pendingHint: Table {{table}} does not exist yet: the three migrations in the package create it on restart.
define.errName: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, up to 44 characters
define.errMigration: Migration number must be 1-4 digits and greater than 0
define.errFieldName: Field names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
define.errReserved: id / tenant_id / created_at / updated_at / deleted_at are system columns and cannot be field names
define.errLength: Length must be an integer between 1 and 4000

config.moduleHint: Lowercase letter first, then letters and digits; used as the Go package, the frontend folder and the i18n namespace
config.goModuleHint: The module in your project's go.mod; defaults to nexadmin

shape.plain: Plain (explicit ID; the current tenant is filled on create when tenant_id exists)

preview.pick: Pick a file on the left

notes.import_line: Add one blank import to internal/modules/modules.go; rebuild and restart to seed the menu:
notes.migration: Three migrations are included; drop them into migrations/business with your project's number and restart to create the table:
notes.null_zero: The table already exists, so no migration is generated; NULL columns are read as zero values and written back as zero values.

done.title: Next steps
done.description: Unzip into the project root, then:

errors.module: Use lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter, up to 31 characters
